evidence.scope: Current core input boundary contrast only. Read the original finding by ID; no Cycle02 behavioral retests or other reviews.
evidence.tokens: Light input is oklch(0.62 0.008 80), independently rendered by Chromium canvas to #898681. Dark input is oklch(0.56 0.008 270), rendered to #727479. Both are opaque.
evidence.method: Rendered current OKLCH colours through Chromium canvas and independently calculated relative luminance and contrast from sampled sRGB pixels, without using scripts/lib/contrast.mjs for the measurements.
evidence.result: All eight input/background combinations exceed 3:1. Lowest measured ratio is 3.2702:1 on light secondary.
evidence.generator: Current tokens.css and tokens.srgb.json exactly match outputs() from scripts/build.mjs; generator was imported without executing its write path.
evidence.regressionCheck: scripts/check.mjs explicitly asserts input contrast >=3 against background, card, popover and secondary in both themes. Its contrast helper computes sRGB relative luminance. It does not composite alpha; current input and tested backgrounds are opaque, so this does not affect this resolution.
